questions.topic: eGurukul · Anti -Thyroid Drugs & Drugs Used in Hypothyroidism
questions.stem: A 28-year-old female with Graves’ disease was taking medication for hyperthyroidism during pregnancy. She delivered a child with congenital anomaly `aplasia cutis congenita’. The most likely drug implicated in this teratogenic effect is?
questions.solutionHtml:
Carbimazole
  • The patient was suffering from Graves’ disease for which she must be taking Antithyroid drugs, probably Carbimazole/Methimazole. As it causes `aplasia cutis congenita’ when taken during pregnancy.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 100,277.

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anti -Thyroid Drugs & Drugs Used in Hypothyroidism
questions.stem: Which type of unresectable thyroid carcinoma can be treated by levothyroxine?
questions.solutionHtml:
Papillary carcinoma of the thyroid
  • Papillary carcinoma of the thyroid is often responsive to TSH.
  • In non-resectable cases, full doses of T4 suppress endogenous TSH production and may induce temporary regression.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 274

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anti -Thyroid Drugs & Drugs Used in Hypothyroidism
questions.stem: If a woman with a history of hypothyroidism becomes pregnant, a dose of levothyroxine needs to-
questions.solutionHtml:
Increased
  • Various studies have proposed that hypothyroid women can increase their LT4 dosage by approximately 30% as soon as the pregnancy is confirmed, thus anticipating the increased need.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 269, 273

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anti -Thyroid Drugs & Drugs Used in Hypothyroidism
questions.stem: Which of the following is incorrect about Methimazole?

options.label: A
options.text: Carbimazole is converted to methimazole after absorption

options.label: C
options.text: Preferred antithyroid drug in grave’s disease

options.label: D
options.text: Used in the first trimester of pregnancy

questions.answerText: Used in the first trimester of pregnancy
questions.solutionHtml:
Used in the first trimester of pregnancy
is an incorrect statement.

As Methimazole is contraindicated in pregnancy and can cause the following teratogenic features:

  • Scalp defects(cutis aplasia)
  • Fetal goiter
  • Choanal and esophageal atresia
  • Omphalocele, omphalomesenteric duct anomalies.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 275

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anti -Thyroid Drugs & Drugs Used in Hypothyroidism
questions.stem: Which of the following is the Mechanism of action of Methimazole?
questions.solutionHtml:
All of the above
  • Methimazole by inhibiting the Thyroid peroxidase enzyme acts by all of the above mechanisms e. Inhibition of Oxidation, Organification, and Coupling.
  • Thereby treating hyperthyroidism.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 275

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anti -Thyroid Drugs & Drugs Used in Hypothyroidism
questions.stem: Propylthiouracil is preferred over Methimazole in the treatment of Thyroid storms because:

options.label: B
options.text: It is less plasma protein bound

options.label: C
options.text: It decreases peripheral conversion of T4 to T3

questions.answerText: It decreases peripheral conversion of T4 to T3
questions.solutionHtml:
It decreases peripheral conversion of T4 to T3
  • Propylthiouracil is preferred over Methimazole in the treatment of Thyroid storm because: Propylthiouracil impairs the peripheral conversion of T4 → T3


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology,By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 275, 276

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anti -Thyroid Drugs & Drugs Used in Hypothyroidism
questions.stem: Following adverse effects are seen with the usage of propylthiouracil except for-
questions.solutionHtml:
Hirsutism
  • Usage of Propylthiouracil causes hair loss, not Hirsutism.
  • Antithyroid drugs (carbimazole and propylthiouracil) can, in rare cases, cause diffuse hair loss. It may be very difficult to tell whether the hair loss is due to the effects of the previous overactivity of the thyroid or the anti-thyroid drugs.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology,By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 275, 276

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anti -Thyroid Drugs & Drugs Used in Hypothyroidism
questions.stem: Fastest acting anti-thyroid drug among the following is-
questions.solutionHtml:
Sodium iodide
  • Iodide limits its own transport and acutely and transiently inhibits the synthesis of iodotyrosine and iodothyronines , thereby preventing the thyroid from synthesizing large quantities of thyroid hormones.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology,By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 277
